measurement.scope: Process-local bounded snapshots of actual primary and recursively followed secondary GPU command buffers during the11th exact Decode request, using observed allocation/map/lock lifetimes. Reuse verified generate objects, runtime and mathematical pack.
caveats: Instrumentation adds QPC and atomic costs. No throughput or speedup is inferred from this executable.
Inclusive host-call durations include nested calls, driver work, preemption and waits; do not sum nested layers or label them DLL boundary overhead.
Only selected entry points are observed. Vendor private/inlined calls, driver internal locks and direct fence-memory polling are not counted.
Vendor observation covers its selected imports and calls resolved via its GetProcAddress IAT after main initialization. Other DLLs and prior cached pointers are outside scope.

Packet snapshots are taken after the original successful submission call. Unknown/truncated packets, unsupported branches and missing CPU mappings are explicit capture failures, never scanned as opcodes.
Primary command bytes exclude secondary command-list bytes, ISA and tensor payloads. Node64 means untracked/multi-context and is rejected by this check.
Application mutex counts span all application call sites in decode, not just HC or a particular thread. No wait-contention attribution from counts alone.
